Modern AI chips don't run on the kind of memory in your gaming PC. They run on something that's literally stacked into a tiny skyscraper, with tens of thousands of microscopic data tunnels drilled through it and a custom silicon motherboard underneath. We sat down with the engineers at Micron to break down how High Bandwidth Memory actually works, why it's the backbone of every serious AI accelerator on the planet, and why your gaming GPU still uses a totally different kind of memory.
